# vendor-corpus

Curated abbreviation/expansion corpus used by the vendor onboarding
review pipeline. Maintained by the integrations team; consumed as a
vendored snapshot by downstream tooling.

| field      | value                    |
|------------|--------------------------|
| format     | CSV (RFC 4180)           |
| schema     | schema.json              |
| versioning | calendar (2026-Q3, …)    |
